blockers.detail: All coordinates are observed from Kiwi 1.0.5. The pinned LW/nFozzy scripts descend from the same Kiwi table and are not independent geometry. Factory drawings and photos corroborate selected identities, quantities and sides. The measured lamp 12/33/34/35 drawing/table discrepancy remains unreconciled; no complete independent per-device placement validation is asserted.

Trough lock coil 1 and five individual trough-switch geometries are absent. Flasher 29 has no admitted socket object; flasher 30 has only one of its two playfield bulbs. Backbox and cabinet coordinates are outside this space.

The table supplies 35 admitted playfield GI bulb objects after render doubles are removed, but the factory schematic shows two feeds without a complete socket-to-feed inventory. No exact physical GI total is asserted; backbox/cabinet quantities and all physical sockets still require reconciliation.

Lamp 12 and tower lamps 33/34/35 differ materially between the measured factory drawing symbols and the script-linked table mesh centres. The drawing shows the tower group farther forward, and 12 farther left and forward. Six floor controls align much more closely, but elevated projection and symbol-to-emitter offsets are unquantified. No alternate physical emitter bound to these addresses was found near the drawing locations. Keep current positions observed; reconcile the source roles before spatial validation. This is a placement limitation, not a machine-design conflict.

coordinate_convention: x=0 left, x=1 right; y=0 rear, y=1 apron; x=raw_x/952, y=raw_y/2162. Six decimal places preserve deterministic table precision, not survey accuracy.

elevated_lamps.symbol: Hatched socket body below the diagonal rail; number 12 is above the rail.
Left hatched body under the tower rail; 33 is the separate label below.
Middle hatched body under the tower rail; the upward arrow from 34 identifies it.
Right hatched body under the tower rail; 35 is the separate label below.

drawing_table_comparison.method: Manual pixel reading of the full native render. Frame corners are the outer playfield drawing border centre lines. Average the two left/right x and rear/front y coordinates to form a comparison rectangle; x=(px-left)/(right-left), y=(py-rear)/(front-rear). No control-point fit. Filled floor insert symbols and hatched elevated socket bodies are measured, not adjacent printed labels. Pixel origin is page top-left, x right and y down.

object_inspection.decision: Keep BulboF12/33/34/35 world-mesh centres as observed table positions with explicit warnings. The unreconciled difference blocks spatial validation; it is not a machine-design conflict.
object_inspection.method: Inspect the exact extraction's Light/Flasher/Primitive objects within 65 VPX units of each drawing point mapped to 952x2162, using world OBJ bounds for primitives, plus every script-bound object for lamp 12/33/34/35. Relevant alternatives are recorded below; nearby screws, brackets, lane wire and a microswitch are not emitters.
object_inspection.near_sign12: MetalGYR1 is hardware, not a script-bound emitter. No alternative Light or bulb primitive was found within 65 VPX units of the comparison point.
object_inspection.near_tower: GIBulb20/GIBulb20g at (102,500.75) and GIBulb21/GIBulb21g at (223,469.25) are GI render pairs driven by local lamp 200 at script lines 980-983, not tower lamps 33/34/35.
object_inspection.rejected_sprites: f12 and f33/f34/f35 are Flasher objects driven by Flash, which changes opacity. Their stored origins and polygons are render geometry, not physical sockets. No sprite position is admitted.
object_inspection.script_bindings: script.vbs 1111-1120: each address drives its BulboF primitive through FlashDLm and its f sprite through Flash; no alternative physical emitter is bound to these addresses.

drawing_table_comparison.status: unreconciled drawing/table comparison; no factory placement inferred

uncertainty.limits: Rounded comparison precision, not a physical survey or statistical confidence interval. Small scan skew, border width and symbol extents are included in the pixel allowance. Elevated sign/tower projection, drawing stylization, emitter-versus-symbol offset and the physical board frame remain unquantified. Floor agreement cannot remove that uncertainty.

lower_flipper_geometry.note: Virtual outputs 45-48 have no physical CPU device placement. Actual lower flippers are modelled by LeftFlipper/RightFlipper; their geometry and the cabinet-controlled upper pair remain table-owned, with the mechanism contract in the definition.

projection_notes.solenoid.12: Botola is the physical trapdoor pivot, not the collidable RampLG helpers.
projection_notes.solenoid.16: Reset-coil coordinate projected onto the middle drop target; not a surveyed coil position.
projection_notes.switch.15: BallRelease is the trough up-kicker's own ball sensor anchor.
